card.name: Inside ALL-CAPS warning text
card.fires_on: Words and word parts inside passages written entirely in capital letters, such as boxed warnings. It often sits on small linking words like OF, IN, AN, or partway through drug names like PENICILLIN.

modes.label: Linking words in caps
modes.description: Short linking words in capitalized warning sentences, before ancestry or country terms.
modes.example: STUDIES IN PATIENTS<< OF>> CHINESE ANCESTRY HAVE

modes.label: Inside capitalized drug names
modes.description: Endings or middle parts of drug names written in capitals.
modes.example: BEFORE INITIATING THERAPY WITH PENICILL<<IN>> V POTASSIUM, CAREFUL

card.writes: It favors upper-case linking words like AND, OR, BUT, IF and disfavors upper-case word starts, so it keeps the model writing in capitals.
card.plain: It marks capital-letter warning text, where the next word should also be in capitals.
